item.title: Elon Musk Says SpaceX-xAI Merger Will Form 'Most Ambitious' Engine With AI
item.description: Elon Musk's SpaceX has acquired xAI, aiming to move AI data centers into orbit, reshape global computing, and fund his long-term vision for space expansion.

item.title: The Bounce Matters: Inside the Rise of Professional-Grade Hoops for Everyday Players
item.description: A basketball is more than a ball: it is ambition in motion, spinning, snapping off hardwood, arching through a hoop with purpose. Yet for decades, backyard basketball for many players around the world meant makeshift goals: a hoop scavenged from a garage sale, a rim mounted on a garage door, or an imported set that promised play but delivered disappointment.

item.title: RBA Lifts Interest Rates by 0.25 Percentage Points, Says Inflation Picked Up in Second Half of 2025
item.description: The Reserve Bank has lifted the interest rates by 0.25 percentage points, and the new cash rate is now at 3.85 per cent.

item.title: Mozilla Gives Firefox Users Power Over AI Features
item.description: Mozilla announced that starting February 24, 2026, Firefox users will gain new AI controls in version 148, allowing them to block or manage generative AI features directly from browser settings.

item.title: Australian Tech Leaders Launch Bid to Revive SXSW in Brisbane Ahead of 2032 Olympics
item.description: More than 100 Australian technology companies have launched a coordinated campaign to bring the renowned South by Southwest (SXSW) festival back to the country, potentially relocating it to Brisbane as part of preparations for the 2032 Olympic and Paralympic Games

item.title: Australia's Top 10 Companies Holding Bitcoin: A Growing Corporate Treasury Trend in 2026
item.description: As Bitcoin's price hovers around US$78,000 in early 2026 amid global market volatility, a small but growing number of Australian companies have embraced digital assets as part of their treasury strategies.

item.title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Set for February 25 Unveiling at Galaxy Unpacked, With March 11 Global Release
item.description: Samsung Electronics is preparing to unveil its flagship Galaxy S26 series, including the premium Galaxy S26 Ultra, at a Galaxy Unpacked event on February 25, 2026, in San Francisco, according to multiple reliable leaks and industry reports.

item.title: Adrian Portelli's LMCT+ Takes Shape as Signage Appears at Former Shell Site in Melbourne
item.description: Signage for billionaire Adrian Portelli's LMCT+ has appeared at a former Shell site in Melbourne

item.title: Another Australian Has Died While Skiing in Japan
item.description: The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade has confirmed that another Australian, a male in his 20s, died while skiing in Japan.

item.title: Notepad++ Hack Reveals Six-Month Backdoor Breach Targeting Millions of Users
item.description: Notepad++ update servers were hijacked for six months, delivering a sophisticated backdoor to users.
